The structure of Li8Bi4Ir4 (reduced formula Li2BiIr) crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Bi and Ir center coordinated by eight Li neighbors, while each Li center has four Bi and four Ir neighbors, all at 2.8628 Å, forming a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Li 8-vertex polyhedra and between Bi and Ir 8-vertex polyhedra.
